name: dsh-plugin-market
description: Open-source plugin market for the DSH web GUI: card grid with GitHub stars, last-commit freshness, and one-click install/uninstall. The catalog is this repo's own data/plugins.json — anyone can add a plugin via pull request. · 开源 DSH 插件市场：卡片式排布、星数、最近提交、一键安装；目录就是本仓库的 data/plugins.json，任何人都能通过 PR 上架插件。
